name: linecat
description: A cat walks a line your Claude Code session unfolds, wearing what Claude is doing overhead; plus retro paper-panel styling for messages, tool rows and a usage monitor

language.title: Language / 语言 / 言語
language.description: Language of Linecat's narration, sheet names and /lineland replies. auto follows Claude Code's response language setting if there is one, else the script of your first prompt.

monitor.title: Resource monitor / 用量监视 / リソースモニター
monitor.description: The usage half of the band above the prompt: 5-hour and 7-day quota and context. Off, the line takes the whole band.

restyle.title: Retro panels / 复古面板 / レトロパネル
restyle.description: Paper panels for messages, tool rows and the thinking line. Off, the app draws them its own way and only the band remains.

place.title: Lineland position / 线国位置 / 線国の位置
place.description: Where the cat and its line are drawn: band, above the prompt beside the usage monitor, or pane, a side pane of their own that no other plugin contends for.
